Good Gardener of the Month

Every month, Good Gardener honors a new person who gives their best to what they do.

We celebrate exceptional work and the dedication that makes it possible. An artist who brings an idea to life. A maker who keeps refining their craft. A person whose care changes the world around them.

The story behind the recognition

Each honoree is featured on the homepage. Their article explains what they do, why their work matters, and what makes them a good gardener.

This is about more than a finished piece of work. It is about the person who shows up for it, again and again.
